summary: Korro Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, announcing the addition of KRRO-111, a development candidate for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency, to its pipeline. The press release and updated corporate presentation were included as exhibits. No financial terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine operational update about preclinical pipeline progress, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
